overview: Black plays 2...f5 against the e4/d4 centre, offering a pawn to open lines against the king. After 3.exf5 Black plays ...Bg7 or ...Nf6 with some activity, but White is simply a pawn up. I am unsure of the details; it is a rare fringe line.

white_ideas.idea: Take on f5 and develop with Nc3 and Nf3
Use the extra pawn and centre

typical_structures.structure: Open f-file and diagonal for Black
White centre pawn plus f5 pawn

character.notes: Black is a pawn down looking for activity.

gambit.notes: Black gives the f-pawn which White can keep.

soundness.notes: White can keep the pawn with a safe king.

character.reason: Black is pawn down for activity and weakens the king.
